text: Sorting rubbish is normal and widespread. Typical bins are brown for organic waste, blue for paper, yellow for plastic and metal packaging, a container for glass by colour, and a bin for general waste, though the details differ by town. Many drinks bottles carry a deposit (Pfand), and you get money back when you return them at a shop.
Many German, Austrian and Swiss cities are good for cycling, and cycling to work is common. A bike lock and lights are important, since cycling at night without lights can be fined.
